nodes.label: Full Save Sheet (fixed 88% height)
nodes.rationale: Post is already saved when sheet appears; title says 已收藏; closing keeps it in 未分類

nodes.norm_label: 分享時用快速面板 setting (meta quick_save)

nodes.rationale: Reads like a magazine article: photo, kicker, WenKai text, byline, hairlines, no colored boxes

nodes.label: 收藏面板 頁面規格
nodes.norm_label: 收藏面板 頁面規格

nodes.label: Backup Export / Import (JSON)
nodes.rationale: Plain JSON readable without the app — Pocket and LINE Keep shutdowns took user data

nodes.label: Smart Tag Suggestions
nodes.rationale: Suggest only, never auto-check: suggestions arrive after fetch and would change state under the finger

nodes.label: Video play button explicit size rule
nodes.norm_label: video play button explicit size rule
nodes.rationale: absoluteFill shrinks on Android so ▶ moves to top

nodes.label: lateSuggestions placement
nodes.rationale: Late suggestions appended after all tags so they don't push targets the user is about to tap

nodes.label: lockPicks / SETTLE_MS 1.5s
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: waiting too long slows one-tap save; not waiting loses same-author signal; buttons locked once drawn

nodes.label: No-shift Layout Principle (targets never move under finger)
nodes.norm_label: no-shift layout principle (targets never move under finger)
nodes.rationale: Measured 136px jump before fixed-height sheet; now 0

nodes.label: Parent tag tap = expand/collapse
nodes.rationale: Prototype showed users mostly pick child tags; select-then-deselect parent was convoluted

nodes.label: R3 Instant Tag Row from Local SQLite
nodes.norm_label: r3 instant tag row from local sqlite

nodes.label: Warm Paper Palette
nodes.rationale: Warm paper-white plus amber avoids the cold-grey minimalism of Pinterest and Are.na.

nodes.label: Typography (System CJK + LXGW WenKai TC)
nodes.rationale: WenKai gives a slight handwritten feel for headings/post text; Bold WenKai used instead of system serif because AOSP lacks a bold zh-Hant serif.

nodes.label: ui-ux-pro-max Generated Design System (Bookmark & Read-Later)
nodes.rationale: Adopted Minimalism & Swiss + Flat style; replaced Poppins with Traditional Chinese fonts; derived dark palette; rejected hover/GSAP for mobile.

nodes.label: Threads 收藏 Design System Master
nodes.norm_label: threads 收藏 design system master
nodes.rationale: Page files override; everything else follows this master. Color changes must pass contrast_check_themes.py with FAILS: 0.

nodes.label: Hidden Panes Keep Size on Web (ui/Pane.js)
nodes.norm_label: hidden panes keep size on web (ui/pane.js)
nodes.rationale: display:none made FlashList measure cards as 0px and mount the entire list; visibility:hidden overlay fixed multi-second renders (web only).

nodes.label: Anti-Patterns (no emoji icons, no badges on photos, single accent...)
nodes.norm_label: anti-patterns (no emoji icons, no badges on photos, single accent...)

nodes.label: Every Long-Press/Swipe Has a Visible Button
nodes.norm_label: every long-press/swipe has a visible button

nodes.label: PressScale containerStyle Rule
nodes.rationale: Layout styles must sit on the pressable itself; prototype FAB had a 0x0 hit area on Android when positioning was on the inner view.

nodes.label: Product Principles (content first, fast save, no forced organizing, offline, no misleading numbers)
nodes.norm_label: product principles (content first, fast save, no forced organizing, offline, no misleading numbers)

nodes.label: Text Color Chosen With Its Surface Rule
nodes.norm_label: text color chosen with its surface rule

nodes.label: Touch Targets (48dp Android / 44pt iOS) and Press Feedback
nodes.norm_label: touch targets (48dp android / 44pt ios) and press feedback

nodes.label: Delete with Undo Toast Instead of Confirm
nodes.norm_label: delete with undo toast instead of confirm

nodes.label: batch.js Set-Based Selection Helpers
nodes.rationale: ids.includes in a loop was O(posts x selected), ~9M comparisons for 全選 on 3000 posts.

nodes.label: 批次選取 Batch Selection (ui/Selection.js)
nodes.rationale: Entry via visible ✓ button rather than long-press-drag, since dragging conflicts with masonry scrolling.

nodes.label: Fake Fetcher Post Codes (IMG1, CAR1, FLAKY1, LOGIN1, GONE1)
nodes.norm_label: fake fetcher post codes (img1, car1, flaky1, login1, gone1)

nodes.label: *.web.js Stand-ins (fake fetcher, in-memory repo, fake backup folder, fake share intent)
nodes.norm_label: *.web.js stand-ins (fake fetcher, in-memory repo, fake backup folder, fake share intent)
nodes.rationale: Web export swaps native pieces for deterministic fakes so the app can be driven in Chromium without the network or a phone.

nodes.label: Navigation Architecture (翻翻 | 收藏 | 串流 tabs)
nodes.norm_label: navigation architecture (翻翻 | 收藏 | 串流 tabs)

nodes.label: until(fn) State Polling Helper
nodes.rationale: Wait for the expected state instead of adding sleeps when a check proves timing-sensitive.

nodes.label: Web Numbers Are a Proxy for Android
nodes.norm_label: web numbers are a proxy for android
nodes.rationale: Desktop Chromium with CPU throttling and react-native-web, not Hermes/Fabric; use only for before/after comparisons.

nodes.label: withReleaseSigning Config Plugin
nodes.rationale: Signs release builds with the user's own key when keystore secrets are provided; otherwise the Expo debug key is kept so new APKs install over old ones.

nodes.label: APK Signing Keys (debug key / ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* secrets)
nodes.norm_label: apk signing keys (debug key / android_keystore_* secrets)
nodes.rationale: Debug key reused so updates install over existing app; switching to own key requires uninstalling once.

nodes.label: Threads_Downloader App
nodes.rationale: One-tap saving of Threads post videos/images into the phone album via Expo / React Native; no backend server or API key needed.

nodes.label: Apple Design Principles for UI
nodes.rationale: Immediate press feedback, critically damped springs, single primary action, always-visible state, haptics only on success/failure, follow system dark mode and reduce-motion.

nodes.label: Hidden WebView with User's Threads Login
nodes.norm_label: hidden webview with user's threads login
nodes.rationale: Logged-out Threads post pages contain no media data, so the user logs in once; login state stays only on the phone, avoiding any backend or API key.

nodes.label: e2e/run.mjs Suite Runner
nodes.rationale: Runs every suite in light and dark (plus film variants), three at a time, retrying once and reporting flaky passes.

nodes.label: 自動標籤規則 Auto Tag Rules (tag_rules / tagRules.js)
nodes.norm_label: 自動標籤規則 auto tag rules (tag_rules / tagrules.js)
nodes.rationale: Rules only add tags on first successful fetch of a new save, never remove, and write in the same update as post content.

nodes.label: 收藏面板 Save Sheet / Quick Panel
nodes.norm_label: 收藏面板 save sheet / quick panel

nodes.label: ImprintMono Date Imprint Font
nodes.rationale: Subset of IBM Plex Mono Medium keeping only digits and date punctuation; renamed ImprintMono because a subset is a Modified Version under OFL and Plex is a Reserved Font Name.

nodes.label: LXGW WenKai TC Subset Font
nodes.rationale: Subset to ASCII/Latin-1, punctuation and Big5 level-1 (6,929 code points) with pyftsubset to keep the APK small (~4 MB per weight instead of ~13 MB); missing glyphs fall back to the system font.

nodes.label: SIL OFL 1.1 License (IBM Plex for ImprintMono)
nodes.norm_label: sil ofl 1.1 license (ibm plex for imprintmono)

nodes.label: Subtle Handwritten Font Choice (WenKai TC)
nodes.rationale: User wanted a slight handwritten feel that isn't obvious; LXGW WenKai TC (OFL) was chosen for titles and post text.

nodes.label: R12 Rediscovery Banner and Tidy Mode
nodes.norm_label: r12 rediscovery banner and tidy mode

nodes.label: Bottom Tabs (翻翻 / 收藏 / 串流)
nodes.norm_label: bottom tabs (翻翻 / 收藏 / 串流)

nodes.label: Review Cards (one year ago, long unseen, random)
nodes.norm_label: review cards (one year ago, long unseen, random)

nodes.label: Unreliable AI Auto-Tagging (A5)
nodes.rationale: mymind auto-tags fail on non-article content; v1 should use user tags plus rule-based suggestions, suggesting rather than auto-applying.

nodes.label: R19 Android Sharing Shortcuts to Tags
nodes.norm_label: r19 android sharing shortcuts to tags

nodes.label: Quick Save Panel and Direct Save Mode
nodes.norm_label: quick save panel and direct save mode

nodes.label: Save First, Organize Later (P1)
nodes.rationale: Best products separate saving from categorizing and route unsorted items to an inbox; Pinterest's forced board selection drew complaints.

nodes.label: Featured Card (full-row)
nodes.rationale: Aspect ratio 0.5–0.75 (0.3–0.45 in 3-col) so a single landscape image does not fill the screen

nodes.label: Stable Props So Memo Cards Skip
nodes.norm_label: stable props so memo cards skip
nodes.rationale: PostCard takes onOpen/onMenu/onRetry(post) instead of per-card closures; runFetch built on stable fetchPost so 精選 renders 1 PostCard.

nodes.label: Overlay Navigation Instead of Expo Router (Phase 1)
nodes.norm_label: overlay navigation instead of expo router (phase 1)
nodes.rationale: Switching to Expo Router was deferred because share-menu integration risk was high and could not be tested on a real device.

nodes.label: Defer Expo Router Migration
nodes.rationale: Expo Router is the project convention but was not adopted this round to avoid risk to the share flow.

nodes.label: Threads Collection Design Spec (MASTER.md, save-sheet, card-wall)
nodes.norm_label: threads collection design spec (master.md, save-sheet, card-wall)

nodes.label: Editorial Palette (ink, paper, single blue accent)
nodes.norm_label: editorial palette (ink, paper, single blue accent)

nodes.label: Masthead (THREADS 收藏誌 · N 篇)
nodes.norm_label: masthead (threads 收藏誌 · n 篇)

nodes.label: Verification Procedure (npm test, lint, web export E2E)
nodes.norm_label: verification procedure (npm test, lint, web export e2e)

nodes.label: 雜誌 (Editorial) Theme
nodes.rationale: Paper-white background, ink text, single blue accent, frameless cards, masthead THREADS 收藏誌.

nodes.label: 底片 (Film) Theme
nodes.rationale: User-selected from clickable previews; photo prints with white edges, date imprint, sprocket rules, square corners.

nodes.label: ImprintMono Date Font (IBM Plex Mono subset)
nodes.norm_label: imprintmono date font (ibm plex mono subset)

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Components may only use semantic names, never hard-coded hex; dark mode is a separately tuned warm gray, not an inversion.

nodes.label: Scroll Feel Fixes (press delay, recyclingKey, getItemType, drawDistance)
nodes.norm_label: scroll feel fixes (press delay, recyclingkey, getitemtype, drawdistance)

nodes.label: Scroll Feel Fixes (press delay, recyclingKey, drawDistance)
nodes.norm_label: scroll feel fixes (press delay, recyclingkey, drawdistance)

nodes.label: npx expo install for SDK-Compatible Versions
nodes.norm_label: npx expo install for sdk-compatible versions

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation (no hand-edited ios/android)
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated; native behavior is configured in app.json and config plugins.

nodes.label: Run Lint and Typecheck Before Done
nodes.norm_label: run lint and typecheck before done

nodes.label: Fetch Versioned Expo Docs Rule
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so agents must read the expo major version and fetch matching docs instead of trusting training data.

nodes.label: Expo Router Migration Deferred
nodes.rationale: Tabs are custom in App.js because expo-share-intent under Expo Router needs +native-intent redirect that only runs natively and can't be verified by web tests.

nodes.label: R1 Download Cover and Dimensions on Save
nodes.norm_label: r1 download cover and dimensions on save

nodes.label: R5 Ghost Post and Deleted Post Handling
nodes.norm_label: r5 ghost post and deleted post handling

nodes.label: Original-Resolution Covers (covers.js)
nodes.rationale: Users asked that thumbnails not be blurry, so original-resolution covers are stored on the phone at save time.

nodes.label: Local Copy Moat (store cover and text on device)
nodes.norm_label: local copy moat (store cover and text on device)
nodes.rationale: Link-only bookmarks go empty when authors delete posts, ghost posts expire in 24h, and Meta CDN URLs expire; saving original cover and text locally at save time is the product's key differentiator.
